issues.competing_evidence: Somova+03 abstract reports 73.5±1.9 min; Somov+04 describes a 37-min narrow-line-peak oscillation and infers a ≈74-min spin, but also a 45-min line-center modulation consistent with a synchronous curtain. Howell+95 assumes synchronism in the AM Her interpretation; Ramsay+04 describes a polar and finds no quasi-coherent XMM modulation.
issues.why_it_matters: Classifying EU UMa as asynchronous changes its physical subtype and affects comparisons of spin/orbit ratios across magnetic CVs.
issues.needed_action: Check for independent later optical, X-ray or polarimetric timing and establish whether the 37-min feature is coherent and half the WD spin. Until then keep WD spin numeric field blank and candidate values separate.

issues.competing_evidence: Ridder+23 Table 3 labels 6(+2/−5)×10^-13 erg cm^-2 s^-1 as 1–10 keV, exactly matching Ramsay+04 Table 2’s unabsorbed bolometric hard-component flux. Ramsay+04 gives no source-native 1–10 keV value in the cited table; 0.1–10 is unavailable.
issues.why_it_matters: Band and bolometric fluxes are not interchangeable; luminosity and population comparisons would be biased if the compatibility scalar is treated as a band-limited flux.
issues.needed_action: Reproduce the source-specific 1–10 keV conversion from the original model/spectrum or obtain confirmation from Ridder+23 authors; meanwhile retain the compatibility scalar with a warning and no 0.1–10 value.

issues.competing_evidence: Schwope review Table 1 visually gives Bcyc1=43 MG and Bpd=43 MG; Bcyc2 and Bph are blank. Its cited reference 5 is “Schwope 1995 (in preparation),” and the underlying spectrum/direct source paper was not retrieved.
issues.why_it_matters: A secondary table and dipole extrapolation must not be mislabeled as direct photospheric or second-pole field measurements.
issues.needed_action: Locate the underlying cyclotron spectrum or original Schwope reference; verify the Bcyc1 value and centered-dipole assumption. Keep Bph blank and Bpd separately typed until verified.

issues.competing_evidence: Sanad+15 quotes state-dependent rates using d=80 pc (Ramsay+04 model distance), Mwd=1 M_sun, Rwd=7e8 cm and LUV=2πfd²; the line-to-bolometric Lacc conversion is not explicit. Gaia/Bailer-Jones geometric distance is about 287 pc.
issues.why_it_matters: Rates scale with distance and adopted WD inputs; treating them as direct measured mass transfer would distort accretion comparisons.
issues.needed_action: If these rates are used quantitatively, retrieve the publisher paper/full derivation and recompute from documented flux-to-Lacc assumptions using a justified distance, preserving the original published model values separately.
